notes:
Bugfix for ace-step lora training - the base/xl-base selector was sending names that did not resolve to real model folders.
Terry gets a use seed toggle, and no longer converts to 32k before the edit. It hears more detail, but caps at 30 seconds instead of 45.
SA3 lora training defaults to 168 layers instead of the full set. Trains faster, and you honestly will not hear a difference. Compatible with gary4juce v4.0.12.
